title: The Book of Life
lead: A heavenly record of the names of God's people. Moses asks to be blotted out of God's book (Exodus 32:32–33); psalms and prophets speak of it (Psalm 69:28; Daniel 12:1); Jesus tells his followers to rejoice that their names are written in heaven (Luke 10:20); and Revelation opens the book at the last judgment (Revelation 20:12–15).
